args.effects: Enable a learnable cultivation operation if feasible. Planting must consume actual required inputs, and any harvest must depend on real growth and conditions, not on this request.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"wren\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability search found no cultivation equivalent. Gather transfers existing ripe stock; probe can inspect or test samples but does not establish planted material or maintain a growing plot. Develop a general cultivation operation, initially executable as a small planting-and-establishment trial. Edibility and zero toxicity do not establish that detached harvested roots can propagate. Resolve propagation and growth against the implementation facts in the current-conversation development handoff, without granting a crop, materials, knowledge or mastery now.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: Cultivate plants, parameterized by mode (plant, tend, inspect, end), actual source-material reference, quantity, plot reference or visible soil coordinate, and actual tending inputs. It applies to compatible plants and propagules rather than only meadow roots. Reuse and record existing targeting, inventory accounting, work, environmental updates and probe observation code; use gather unchanged for any genuinely exposed ripe harvest. Do not claim those functions as new development.\\nPrerequisites: individual study; actor alive, able to act and within interaction reach; actual accessible soil and lawful control of any consumed material. A planting trial may use one whole owned root whose identity, condition and quantity are checked at execution. Neither a regenerative crown nor a viable bud is inferred from the resource name. Candidate reference item-4-wren-47 currently holds three root units with recorded decay, but these are not reserved by this review. Source start-0-roots is an observed mature plant, not free planting stock: its two stock units remain untouched unless a separate valid gather action occurs. Nearby observed plants similarly confer no inputs. Recorded soil value 0.65 is evidence about those plants, not proof that an arbitrary destination is suitable.\\nSmallest executable version: prepare a small soil location by hand and plant one actual whole root as a labeled experimental propagule, preserving its identity and condition. One root per trial avoids assuming that cut pieces regenerate. No tool is mandatory for loose, hand-workable soil; hard ground or inaccessible roots require actual appropriate tools or fail validation. Planting takes two active rounds and 3 energy total, charged as 1.5 per completed round: first prepare and record the site, then transfer the root into the plot. Validate location, occupancy and input again before transfer. No water, fertilizer or tool is conjured. The root leaves inventory and cannot simultaneously be eaten or used elsewhere. Retain its material quantity and food condition in the plot ledger; planting creates no extra nutrition or mature plant stock.\\nImplementation handoff must inspect the actual plant, resource and environmental handlers and establish whether detached roots, intact crowns, division or some other real propagule are supported. If the root is unsuitable, report that finding when physically established; do not silently convert it into seed. If viability is unresolved, the supported product is a planted trial, not a promised crop. A non-destructive visible inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy using recorded probe logic; it reveals only presently observable condition. A destructive sample uses probe's existing one-round, 0.5-energy, 0.1-material-unit contract and debits the planted specimen. This is not automatic proof of propagation.\\nProduction support requires a coded species-compatible establishment/growth rule before activation. The handoff must supply exact propagule requirements, growth duration, suitable temperature/moisture/soil ranges, environmental stress and decay, biomass accounting and finite yield from the authoritative implementation facts. Do not invent these from the known nutrition value or label. If those mechanisms cannot yet be grounded, enable the physical planting/monitoring precursor only, explicitly showing that future food production remains unverified. This restriction is not a permanent rejection of cultivation. No generic fixed-era unlock or invented sequence of activities is required.\\nTending is an explicit action, not a free background benefit: one round and 1 energy per plot treatment, plus the exact measured quantity of any supplied water or other supported input. Treatment is enabled only when its material requirements and effect are implemented; dry hand movement cannot increase moisture. Reject invalid treatment before costs. Existing passive environmental rules continue to affect planted material, including its condition and any applicable drought or waterlogging, without revealing unobserved future hazards. Once supported growth exists, elapsed simulation time and actual conditions, not repeated requests or inspections, advance it. Photosynthesis must require actual light and suitable conditions, water and nutrients must have declared sources and accounting, and harvested stock must be debited from finite grown biomass. No root multiplication solely from waiting, planting, naming or paying energy.\\nPersist plot identity, coordinates, source stack identity, transferred quantity, condition, preparation/planting work, treatments, observation times and any implemented growth state. Interrupted work retains completed preparation and paid effort. Resumption revalidates reach, site and surviving inputs; it neither repeats charges for completed work nor skips remaining work. Cancellation before transfer leaves the root in inventory; after transfer it remains physically planted. There is no automatic root or energy refund. Any unconsumed reserved inputs are released once, never duplicated. Ending the trial stops active work but does not erase material or environmental consequences. Death stops the actor's work and releases surviving reservations under ordinary death/drop rules; an existing plot remains subject to world processes. Independent actors may tend it only through their own authorized actions. No consent, assistance or communication is inferred. Review/development waiting advances neither world time nor growth. Learning itself supplies no plot or inputs.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"No benefit for requesting, registration, naming, study completion or purported mastery. A measured viability result, visible establishment or informative physical failure may qualify as verified information gain only when new to this actor and supported by an observation event. Deduplicate equivalent findings across probe and cultivation; repeated inspection without changed evidence grants nothing. If the established experience code supports such events, use at most one short-pleasure unit per distinct verified finding with a 10-round same-function cooldown. Completed, personally applicable care may sustain modest satisfaction through legitimate familiar practice: at most one contribution per 10 rounds, capped at 1 total cultivation satisfaction and decaying by 0.002 per elapsed round without qualifying maintenance. Route these through existing bounded experience rules, not protected reward accounts, budget, goals or permissions; do not create an account merely to award them. Planting or a failed trial provides no nutrition or automatic comfort. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, and mood never reduces basic nutritional requirements.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable events only after the corresponding physical change: site_prepared, propagule_planted, treatment_applied, condition_observed, establishment_observed, trial_failed and, only when implemented and achieved, crop_matured. Include reusable metadata for plot/source IDs, coordinates, material and quantity, actual stage, work progress, timestamp and observation scope. Reuse plant/plot rendering with state labels such as prepared, planted-unverified, visibly sprouting, stressed or dead; unverified planting must not use the existing ready visual or show harvestable stock. Display growth only from real supported state transitions. Interrupted work shows retained partial progress; invalid actions show no planted or successful-treatment event. Failure observations describe what was seen and do not visually assert an untested biological cause. Private condition data and future hazards must not leak through labels or graphics.\"}]}"}
